analyst.summary: 360 ONE WAM (formerly IIFL Wealth) is India's largest listed UHNI wealth manager, with AUM at a record ₹7.77 lakh crore and revenue still growing strongly (+26.8% YoY in the June-2026 quarter), but profit growth is now trailing revenue growth for two straight quarters as the core Wealth Management segment's margins compress, and the stock's 36x P/E already prices in more than that decelerating trend is currently delivering. A ₹336 crore income-tax demand tied to a January-2025 search action adds a contested but solvency-immaterial legal overhang. Rated Hold: a quality franchise, but not cheap enough for the earnings-quality wobble showing up in the last two prints.
